I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time weather data. However, I can give you a general idea of what the weather is usually like in San Francisco:

| Season | Typical Temperature | Weather Notes |
|--------|---------------------|---------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 48–58 °F (9–14 °C) | Cool, often cloudy, occasional fog. |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 55–68 °F (13–20 °C) | Mild, less fog, more sunshine. |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 57–70 °F (14–21 °C) | Warm, dry, but still cooler than many other California cities; fog can linger near the coast. |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | 55–68 °F (13–20 °C) | Pleasant, similar to spring. |

If you need an up‑to‑date forecast, you might want to check a reliable weather service like the National Weather Service, Weather.com, or a weather app on your phone. Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
